intentionalEvidenceBoundaries: Documentation, Architecture, Knowledge, Metadata and Twin quality-score axes remain absent until an existing authority defines a deterministic numeric source; Quality Center never invents a formula.
line/branch/function/statement coverage remains NOT_AVAILABLE unless a real coverage-summary artifact exists; enabling mandatory Vitest coverage requires an explicit dependency/CI-cost decision.
FinTech value-chain projection validates structural/evidence connectivity and hot-path isolation; it never changes financial scores, confidence, ranking, provider routing or eligibility.

Commit-bound CI artifact history remains outside this slice pending a separately authorized workflow-security change; long-term product-side Quality trend persistence remains outside this slice until an existing persistence authority and explicit production-mutation approval define the storage path.

Skill Engine prompt compilation and catalog validation are local/read-only. No LLM provider call, repository mutation, Concept-ID creation, merge, release or production action is part of Skill Engine v1.0.0.

authorityBoundary: Quality results and Skill Engine outputs are measurement/evidence only and cannot authorize merge, release, deployment, production mutation, policy changes, vocabulary approval, financial scoring changes, ranking changes or privilege elevation.
